subject: [PATCH v3 08/11] mm, swap: only charge physical swap entries

2026-08-06.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Linux kernel's memory control group (memcg) and swap management to only charge physical swap entries, rather than charging for virtual swap entries when they are allocated. This change ensures that memory.swap.current accurately tracks on-disk swap usage, preventing overcharging of zswap-backed or zero-filled pages. As a result, cgroups with all pages in zswap can reclaim anonymous memory even if memory.swap.max is set to 0.
